title: Bridging the Gap: Converting Read Text to Conversational Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2605.18001v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In recent advancements within speech processing, converting read speech to conversational speech has gained significant attention. The primary challenge in this domain is maintaining naturalness and intelligibility while minimizing computational overhead for real-time applications. Traditional read speech often lacks the nuanced prosodic variation essential for natural conversational interactions, posing challenges for applications in virtual assistants, customer service, and language learning tools. This paper introduces a novel approach, Prosodic Adjustment with Conversational Context (PACC), aimed at converting read speech into natural conversational speech used in various modern applications. PACC utilizes advanced deep neural networks to analyze and modify prosodic features such as intonation, stress, and rhythm. translated_title: 弥合差距：将朗读文本转换为会话对话
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.18001v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在语音处理的最新进展中，将朗读语音转换为会话语音受到了广泛关注。该领域的主要挑战在于在保持自然度和可懂度的同时，尽量减少实时应用的计算开销。传统的朗读语音往往缺乏自然会话交互所必需的细微韵律变化，这给虚拟助手、客户服务和语言学习工具等应用带来了挑战。本文提出了一种新颖的方法——基于会话语境的韵律调整（Prosodic Adjustment with Conversational Context，PACC），旨在将朗读语音转换为各种现代应用中使用的自然会话语音。PACC利用先进的深度神经网络来分析和修改语调、重音和节奏等韵律特征。与传统方法不同，我们的方法采用高保真生成对抗网络（HiFi-GAN）进行语音合成……
tldr: 本文提出PACC方法，利用深度神经网络和HiFi-GAN对韵律特征进行分析与调整，将朗读语音转换为自然流畅的会话语音，同时兼顾实时应用的自然度、可懂度与低计算开销。
